The purpose of this article is to list the best known sensor brands with associated part numbers. The Siemens ECUs in our vehicles are very sensitive and don't perform well without the right brand sensors. Using sensors outside of this list will result in unpredictable results. In most cases the Hyundai part is a white labeled and repackaged sensor from the sensors within this list. Even reputable brands such as Bosch will '''not''' perform in the majority of our sensor locations causing more problems. There are exceptions to the rule, however.

== 2.7L Sensors ==

* Hyundai 39180-37150, 39180-37200
* NTK EH0220
* MANDO 22A1223

* NTK EC0145
* MANDO 22A1218

* Continental/VDO  5WK9643Z (5WK96050Z Is also compatible from BMW)
